prompts.name: cover-plum
prompts.prompt:
Re-layout the supplied green-plum campaign poster for a NEW exact canvas: WIDTH 1086 px × HEIGHT 1383 px, width/height 0.78525, approximately 4:5 portrait. It must be broader than the tall reference. Full-bleed sharp illustrated artwork all the way to every edge; NO blurred sides, padding, panels, blank borders, inset poster or stretched objects.

Chinese rural watercolor and guofeng illustration. Preserve the reference's dark forest-green and jade palette, white Song-style title, blossom branches, green plum fruit cluster, orchard, ochre preserving urn, cream-and-gold clouds and red "梅" seal. Recompose for the wider 1086×1383 canvas: compact upper typography, large fruit spreading across the lower half, jar lower right. The reference is a CONTENT/STYLE reference, NOT the required output dimensions.
Keep all typography and the seal within x=12–88% and y=12–87%, so small responsive crops remove only decorative background. Clear margins around the seal.
All text must be exactly:
农事活动预告 · 春季篇
后山梅子园
青梅封坛
青梅采摘 · 封存一整个春天
3月25日 开放预约
Red seal: 梅
Eyebrow and place near upper center, very large white title below, subtitle then yellow booking capsule. No additional lettering or watermarks.
